units.source_text: 那时我四五岁，连一个片假名、平假名都不认识。

en.t: At the time I was four or five years old, and did not even know a single katakana or hiragana character.

units.source_text: 不知母亲是怎么想的，双方酣战的时候，

en.t: I do not know what my mother was thinking, but while the two sides were locked in their fierce contest,

units.source_text: 她冷不防地凝视着我的脸问道：“懂吗，小龙枝？

en.t: she suddenly stared into my face and asked, "Do you understand, little Tatsue?

units.source_text: 你总是那样老实地望着我。”

en.t: You are always looking at me so earnestly like that."

units.source_text: 然后一边爱抚我的头，一边说：“你也来玩吧。

en.t: Then, while stroking my head affectionately, she said, "You come and play too.
Little Tatsue can take one card too, you know."

units.source_text: 我这个对手是个无知的幼儿。

en.t: Their opponent, me, was an ignorant small child.

units.source_text: 大家把刚伸出的手又缩了回去，直勾勾地盯着我一个人。

en.t: Everyone drew back the hands they had just reached out and fixed their eyes squarely on me alone.
